simple.meaning: גֶּפֶן (gephen) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a vine (as twining ), especially the grape.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 55 times across Genesis, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, 1 Kings, and 14 more, beginning at Genesis 40:9. Its contexts include land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גֶּפֶן (H1612).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: גֶּפֶן (gephen) / H1612 is traced through Genesis 40:9, Genesis 40:10, Genesis 49:11, Numbers 6:4 as a generated source-based concept entry.
